name: Nunatsiavut (Canada)
description: A white field bearing a large inukshuk of grey-outlined stones — white above, green in the middle and blue below.
history: Flag of Nunatsiavut, the Inuit self-governing region of northern Labrador established by the 2005 Labrador Inuit land-claims agreement. The inukshuk, the Inuit stone waymarker, is built in the three colours of the Labrador Inuit: white snow, green land, blue sea.

features.role: inukshuk of white, green and blue stones
features.symbolism: the Inuit waymarker in the colours of snow, land and sea
